Team,

For Q1, I want all Enterprise-industry leads with C-suite titles (CEO, CFO, CTO, COO) marked as 'Hot Lead' instead of the standard qualification status. These accounts need personal executive attention this quarter.

Also a reminder: the all-hands is moved to Thursday.

Best,
Sarah James
VP of Sales"}
